0.Name: Upper
Text: Level three micromodule. Builds up engine and radar power via enhancements to energy conversion.

1.Name: Electro
Text: Level three micromodule. Affects the power of energy weapons, using the principle of impulse generator multiplication.

10.Name: Faejoel
Text: Level three micromodule. Added to the engine's navigational system, thus increasing the clock frequency of the device's computing module. Compatible exclusively with <clr>faeyan<clrEnd> equipment.

100.Name: Integrator
Text: Level two micromodule. Increases the weapon's hit coefficient via a singular increase of the initial impulse.

101.Name: Magnicum
Text: Level two micromodule. Increases the potential of the gripper-generated field, thus increasing the efficiency of the device.

102.Name: Stopbark
Text: Level two micromodule. Replaces moving equipment parts with stronger platinum ones. Decreases the size and increases the cost of the equipment. Cannot be used in weapon systems or hull.

103.Name: Impalegun
Text: Level two micromodule. Replaces the scanner's magnetic generator with a more expensive impulse-gravitational variant, thus increasing the power of the device.

104.Name: Paragon
Text: Level two micromodule. Replaces the gripper's power source with one that's both more powerful and expensive. However, the new generator is also larger in size. Incompatible with any <clr>peleng<clrEnd> equipment.

105.Name: Strutter
Text: Level two micromodule. Generates a zero-friction field, decreasing the engine's output power loss while increasing both the speed and jumping range. Compatible exclusively with <clr>maloq<clrEnd> equipment.

106.Name: Convector
Text: Level two micromodule. Fitted into the mechanical component of the device. Increases the scanner's power and radar range. Compatible exclusively with <clr>human<clrEnd> equipment.

107.Name: Clip
Text: Level two micromodule. Replaces the larger boards with smaller, modern analogues. Reduces the size of any equipment or weapon, except for the hull. Compatible exclusively with <clr>faeyan<clrEnd> equipment.

108.Name: Microshooter
Text: Level two micromodule. Replaces the coordinate system of the corrective module with a faeyan ecliptic system, increasing the weapons' range and the engine's hyperjump distance. Incompatible with <clr>maloq and peleng<clrEnd> equipment.

109.Name: Displacement
Text: Level two micromodule. Modifies the engine's acceleration system, thus increasing the jumping range in hyperspace. Adapted for <clr>peleng and human<clrEnd> engines.

11.Name: Rustle
Text: Level three micromodule. Increases the efficiency of the disturbance filter in the shield generator. The active micromodule takes up a rather large amount of space.

110.Name: Dronze
Text: Level two micromodule. Upgrades vector-type accumulators, thanks to which the droid can work longer, and thus repair more damage. Useless for <clr>human, faeyan, and gaalian<clrEnd> droids.

111.Name: Dioshield
Text: Level two micromodule. Replaces the moving parts in the shield generator and missile weapons with dominator action-type elements. A joint invention of <clr>faeyans and humans<clrEnd>, compatible exclusively with the equipment of these races.

112.Name: Maform
Text: Level two micromodule. Applies physical deformation to compensating modules on <clr>maloq<clrEnd> weapons by enlarging them and thus boosting damage capacity and reliability. Due to this being one of the most expensive knots, the weapon's cost increases sharply.

113.Name: Volumer
Text: Level two micromodule. Curves the space inside the reservoir, enabling increased fuel storage while the tank's weight and size remain unchanged. Compatible with <clr>peleng and faeyan<clrEnd> equipment.

114.Name: Splinter
Text: Level two micromodule. Controls the lock mechanism of fragmentation weapons, increasing firing efficiency. Compatible with <clr>maloq and peleng<clrEnd> weapons.

115.Name: Colebrator
Text: Level two micromodule. Improves the characteristics of device wave emitters. Increases the power of equipment that uses continuous emission and fields with wave characteristics, such as radar, gripper and shield generator.

116.Name: Energos
Text: Level two micromodule. Added as an auxiliary device into the bundle synthesizer for energy type weapons.

117.Name: Armorpack
Text: Level two micromodule. Equips the ship's hull with additional sheets of composite armor. The gyroscope hinged fixes of armor plates and shock absorbers placed within the hull occupy rather a large space, substantially reducing the ship's storage capacity.

118.Name: Insighter
Text: Level two micromodule. A quasi-intellectual module, substantially boosting the power of <clr>gaalian<clrEnd> radars and scanners through use of "pseudo-intuition."

119.Name: Turing
Text: Level two micromodule. Replaces a massive weapons turret for power support. Part of the generator's energy is used to absorb the kickback, thereby reducing range and firepower, but the weapon occupies half as much space.

12.Name: Dalstar
Text: Level three micromodule. Boosts equipment range by eliminating a statistical computation error made by peleng equipment when calculating in limit intervals. Compatible exclusively with <clr>peleng<clrEnd> equipment.

120.Name: Excalibur
Text: Level two micromodule. Invented by human scientists, this micromodule modifies energy weapon converters, substantially increasing their killing capacity. Out of patriotic considerations, this module is compatible exclusively with <clr>human<clrEnd> equipment.

121.Name: Exploder
Text: Level two micromodule. Built into the engine. Destabilizes the molecular structure of the fuel, increasing its detonation properties. This provides a boost to engine speed, while reducing hyperjump distance due to a higher overload. Unfortunately, <clr>maloq<clrEnd> engines cannot sustain the increased load.

122.Name: Patch 0.95 beta
Text: Level two micromodule. Contains a set of broaching modules, designed for software integration with computing and overriding functions of certain equipment types. The patch increases the speed and accuracy of computations with a floating point. Still fairly raw and untested, the patch tends to conflict with <clr>faeyan and maloq<clrEnd> equipment software.

123.Name: Optimator
Text: Level two micromodule. Removes non-functional and decorative nodes and components out of <clr>peleng<clrEnd> equipment, thus decreasing its dimensions and cost while increasing reliability. Not used for hulls and weapon systems.

124.Name: Addon
Text: Level two micromodule. Enhances the hull with an additional cargo bay, increasing its capacity by 15%. Cannot be applied to <clr>peleng<clrEnd> hulls for unknown reasons.

125.Name: Gorand
125.Text: Level two micromodule. Replaces <clr>armanent<clrEnd> components with nanotechnology-made analogs. Increases reliability by <clr>80%<clrEnd> and cost by <clr>30%<clrEnd>.

13.Name: Minisized
Text: Level three micromodule. Replaces a number of large texoelements with more compact ones, and very cheap to boot. Compatible exclusively with <clr>human<clrEnd> equipment. Does not interface with energy and missile weapons, as well as the hull.

14.Name: Dronner
Text: Level three micromodule. Increases droid capabilities by replacing some of its components with a more efficient variety, albeit heavier. The droid's weight is increased as a result.

15.Name: Cent
Text: Level three micromodule. Affects the material component of any item (save for the hull), slightly increasing the item's size. At the same time, the cost is reduced by <clr>three quarters<clrEnd>, making the next maintenance worthwhile.

16.Name: Massodrope
Text: Level three micromodule. Removes redundant service blocks from the droid (such as noise-, radiation-protection, idiot-proofing, etc.), replacing it with auxiliary maintenance modules. Increasing droid effectiveness and lowering it's cost, this operation can only be performed on <clr>maloq and peleng<clrEnd> droids.

17.Name: Platicoat
Text: Level three micromodule. Covers the equipment with a thin coat of platinum, increasing its value.

18.Name: Klein
Text: Level three micromodule. Boosts the power of any weapon at the expense of range.

19.Name: Paxton
Text: Level three micromodule. Allows for a more rational rearrangement of shield generator elements in <clr>maloq<clrEnd> technology, thus leading to a reduction in size. Functionality is not affected, though power is slightly reduced.

2.Name: Rocketon
Text: Level three micromodule, containing unfocused beta-conductors. Significantly boosts the power of missile weapons, and partly that of energy weapons.

20.Name: Gugaal
Text: Level three micromodule. Allows for maximum utilization of the speed potential of <clr>gaalian<clrEnd> engines, built into the design but rarely tapped by the modern engine systems. Though fairly minor from a structural standpoint, the cost of the engine is nonetheless increased by <clr>25%<clrEnd>.

200.Name: Harding
Text: Level one micromodule. Built into the hull. Secures a dedicated micronetwork of repulsive stationary nanobots, partly blocking incoming damage. Compatible exclusively with <clr>peleng and human<clrEnd> hulls.

201.Name: Jumpgator 3.11
Text: Level one micromodule. Patches the software part of the navigation and instant engine correction modules to Version 3.11, increasing the engine's jumping range.

202.Name: Extremer
Text: Level one micromodule. Increases the hull's capacity and cost by retrofitting the cargo bay for better space utilization and removing non-functional components. Compatible exclusively with <clr>maloq<clrEnd> hulls.

203.Name: Jake
Text: Level one micromodule. Replaces fuel filters, increasing fuel purification and boosting engine speed thereby.

204.Name: Universe
Text: Level one micromodule. Built into the standard expansion slot of any equipment. Integrates into the operation of the device, optimizing its computational and functional circuits.

205.Name: Iikebaanite
Text: Level one micromodule. Applies a decorative coating the color of a completed gaalian iike-baana to any <clr>gaalian<clrEnd> equipment. The equipment increases in cost by 2.5 times.

206.Name: Minivision
Text: Level one micromodule. Replaces the radar navigation unit with a new miniature, highly balanced and efficient element.

207.Name: Microsize
Text: Level one micromodule. Reduces the space within the molecular networks of any equipment and compensates for changes in intermolecular forces. Cannot be applied to hulls or weapons without disabling their functionality. The micromodule greatly affects reliability and allows for a size reduction of <clr>30%<clrEnd>. Incompatible with <clr>gaalian<clrEnd> equipment.

208.Name: Jumpa
Text: Level one micromodule. Installs a new generation converter, enabling a short-term boost in the fuel's energy potential, thereby increasing jumping range and reliability.

209.Name: Threader
Text: Level one micromodule. Ups the explosive power of fragmentation weapons by increasing critical mass. The weapon's cost is increased by <clr>50%<clrEnd>. Compatible exclusively with <clr>maloq and peleng<clrEnd> weapons.

21.Name: Patch 0.96 alpha
Text: Level three micromodule. Contains a set of broaching modules, designed for software integration with computing and overriding functions of certain equipment types. The patch increases the speed and accuracy of computations with a floating point. The alpha-version is compatible with the equipment of all races.

210.Name: Antifae
Text: Level one micromodule. Increases the payload of missile weapons. For reasons unknown the module is rejected by <clr>faeyan<clrEnd> equipment.

211.Name: Farsight
Text: Level one micromodule. Adds an additional atmic homing system to weapons, increasing the effective radius of energy and fragmentation weapons. An inbuilt atmic scanner results in increased volume. Incompatible with <clr>gaalian<clrEnd> weapons.

212.Name: Hocus
Text: Level one micromodule. Alters the fluctuation intervals of the gripper's wave field to better match the specs of the target's material, boosting the field penetrating capacity and thus the gripper's power.

213.Name: Dimin
Text: Level one micromodule. Special nanobots modify the molecular structure of the fuel, reducing its factual volume and thus enabling increased fuel storage without making changes to the actual equipment. Compatible with <clr>gaalian and human<clrEnd> equipment.

214.Name: Drover
Text: Level one micromodule. Modifies the engine's crystal fillers, boosting speed and jumping range. Compatible with <clr>maloq<clrEnd> engines.

215.Name: Broing
Text: Level one micromodule. This one-of-a-kind and quite costly generator creates a surface repulsion field which consumes high levels of heat and kinetic energies and redirects them to boost the protective properties of the ship's hull and shield generator. Compatible exclusively with <clr>peleng<clrEnd> equipment.

216.Name: Burnz
Text: Level one micromodule. Enhances shells with additional impact elements, using antimatter particles. Grants a significant power boost, especially to fragmentation weapons. Compatible with <clr>gaalian and peleng<clrEnd> weapons.

217.Name: Shell
Text: Level one micromodule. Bombs the hull with high-frequency energy quanta, boosting the material's protective attributes. The module comes standard with hull manufacturers of all races except for <clr>maloqs<clrEnd>, meaning only maloq hulls can be upgraded with it.

218.Name: Redusa
Text: Level two micromodule. Reduces the internal diameter of the engine's nozzles through accruing composite crystalloids, resulting in increased jet velocity. Compatible exclusively with <clr>peleng<clrEnd> engines.

219.Name: Hub
Text: Level one micromodule. Fixes an additional hub-module onto the hull, increasing volume by 25%. Initially developed exclusively for <clr>human<clrEnd> hulls, the module was later licensed by the <clr>fae<clrEnd> and adapted for their ships.

220.Name: Lambald
220.Text: Level one micromodule. Performs device parts processing using femtosecond L-field impulses. Increases reliability by <clr>120%<clrEnd>. Due to limited power output, interaction with <clr>hull<clrEnd> is impossible.

23.Name: Berserker
Text: Level three micromodule. Upgrades weapon systems with a rather massive particle accelerator and antimatter generator, substantially increasing the weapon's combat effectiveness.

24.Name: Interdesign
Text: Level three micromodule. Increases the hull's capacity by 7% through retrofitting the ship's compartments for better space utilization.

25.Name: Staxer
Text: Level three micromodule. Thanks to engine operating conditions optimization increases its reliability and jump radius. Because of license agreement restrictions, cannot be used with <clr>gaal<clrEnd> engines.

3.Name: Brond
Text: Level three micromodule. Capable of rapidly generating superdense particles to augment the ship's defense system. Compatible with hulls and shield generators.

300.Name: Forcer
300.Text: Level two micromodule. Built into the hull. Activates scanner, radar and afterburner slots.

301.Name: Diamant
301.Text: Level three micromodule. Built into the hull. Activates repair droid and gripper slots.

302.Name: Jeiad
302.Text: Level three micromodule. Built into the hull. Activates shield generator and gripper slots.

303.Name: Rasta
303.Text: Level three micromodule. Built into the hull. Activates repair droid and shield generator slots.

304.Name: Prozotor
304.Text: Level one micromodule. Built into the hull. Activates one weapon and one artifact slot.

305.Name: Armorer
305.Text: Level one micromodule. Built into the hull. Activates two weapon slots.

306.Name: Perforator
306.Text: Level one micromodule. Built into the hull. Activates two artifact slots.

353.Name: Fast Hull I
Text: <color=248,252,248>The streamline form of this hull has zero bearing on its speed, for there is no air resistance in outer space. It is simply a tribute to fashion. The boost in speed is actually achieved via a clever engine position and enhanced fuel injection.</color>

357.Name: Invincible Hull I
Text: <color=248,252,248>A hull with bolstered defensive properties, developed by faeyan specialists. A special acrynic layer inserted between the hull's armor plates improves the operational effectiveness of the shield generator.</color>

358.Name: Invincible Hull II
Text: <color=248,252,248>A hull with bolstered defensive properties, developed by faeyan specialists. A special acrynic layer inserted between the hull's armor plates improves the operational effectiveness of the shield generator.</color>

360.Name: Invincible Hull IV
Text: <color=248,252,248>A hull with bolstered defensive properties, developed by faeyan specialists. A special acrynic layer inserted between the hull's armor plates improves the operational effectiveness of the shield generator.</color>

361.Name: Repair Hull I
Text: <color=248,252,248>This hull is designed to optimize the repair droid's working capacity. It is stationed at the most convenient location with easy access to all the ship's most vulnerable parts. As a result, the droid operates with greater effectiveness than on other ships.</color>

362.Name: Repair Hull II
Text: <color=248,252,248>This hull is designed to optimize the repair droid's working capacity. It is stationed at the most convenient location with easy access to all the ship's most vulnerable parts. As a result, the droid operates with greater effectiveness than on other ships.</color>

365.Name: Myoplasmic Hull I
Text: <color=248,252,248>Myoplasmic equipment utilizes special acrynic agents, fitted into the ship's energy system, which redirect power flows to boost the power of fragmentation and energy weapons. As a side effect, may also decrease the ship's speed.</color>

369.Name: Pygamore Hull I
Text: <color=248,252,248>The pygamore series was the first to utilize acrynic technologies. Its only advantage lies in preservation of energy, whose surplus can then be used to bolster missile launchers. Its drawbacks include frequent malfunctions and systems errors. As a result, the radar and the shield generator require constant reboots, hindering their effectiveness.</color>

4.Name: Resizer
Text: Level three micromodule. Softens and deforms the walls of the fuel tank, increasing its capacity.

489.Name: Dumbo Hull V
Text: <color=248,252,248>This exclusive hull arrived on the market straight from the Farinapini design studio, where it received a full makeover. 490.Name: Shadow of the Empire

Only one copy has been made thus far, which is currently being field tested by the Coalition special forces.</color>

498.Name: Acrynator
Text: A one-of-a-kind handmade level one micromodule. The only copy of the latest experimental model from the Coalition engineers in the field of acrynic technologies. Triples all the special effects of <clr>acrynic<clrEnd> equipment and neutralizes all of its negative effects. Size and costs of the equipment are doubling. Cannot be installed on a hull due to a conflict with outdated connectors.

5.Name: Inliner
Text: Level three micromodule. Built into the scanner's inline module, increases the spectrum of frequencies received.

500.Name: Diphrode
Text: A Diphrode series kit of modified weapons bundles and software mods, boosting the firepower of various weapon types.

501.Name: Liphocarus
Text: A modernized version of the Liphocarus project, this armament deals additional damage to already damaged targets, utilizing a mechanism of super-accurate repeated fire into the hull's holes.

502.Name: Adropter
Text: Adropter comes with a kit of supplemental equipment and utilizes the blast wave localizer method. The pirate technology is far from perfect, but it still increases the chance of preserving valuable trophies after the enemy ship is destroyed.

503.Name: Stylermain
Text: Stylermain is a modification that's installed on a gun mount. During combat, besides regular fire it attempts to transmit an emergency signal to the enemy ship's central control system with a command to dump its cargo. The success rate is relatively low, but it may occasionally give the pilot a tactical advantage in battle and a shot at some easy loot.
Probability of goods being dumped from the cargo bay: <clr>5%<clrEnd>

504.Name: Javitor
Text: Modified for precision targeting of repair droids, the Javitor weapon model concentrates fire along the droid's trajectory, thus increasing the chance to block the enemy ship's attempts at repair during combat.
The chance to block a <clr>droid<clrEnd> is inversely proportional to the target's hull size

505.Name: Inveiter
Text: In addition to the weapon's regular function, the Inveiter modified version suppresses the enemy ship's ignition system, damaging its engine in the process.

6.Name: Antent
Text: Level three micromodule. Enhances the specs of scanning and radar devices. Built into the antenna amplifier, boosting its power.

7.Name: Botter
Text: Level three micromodule. Upgrades the repair droid's firmware, improving its accuracy and effectiveness, and giving a <clr>67%<clrEnd> increase in reliability. Compatible exclusively with <clr>faeyan<clrEnd> droid types.

8.Name: Farshooter
Text: Level three micromodule. Reduces the lag effect of the weapon's corrective systems, increasing firing range.

9.Name: Vortex
Text: Level three micromodule. Contains an additional, high-accuracy microcontroller for the engine's navigational systems. Upgraded computational functions lead to increases in speed and jumping range. Compatible exclusively with <clr>human<clrEnd> engines.
